map.宫高/腹围与胎儿体重（Hadlock） 使用指南: Fundal Height/Abdominal Girth and Fetal Weight (Hadlock) User Guide
map.按宫高、腹围与 Hadlock 公式估算胎儿体重，用于产前监护参考，纯前端计算非: Estimate fetal weight from fundal height, abdominal girth and the Hadlock formula for antenatal monitoring reference; pure front-end calculation, not a diagnosis, and the result must be interpreted by a doctor together with ultrasound.
map.产检用宫高×腹围粗估胎儿体重，快速筛查。: Fundal height times abdominal girth gives a rough estimate of fetal weight in antenatal care, for rapid screening.
map.资源有限时替代超声做体重分级。: A substitute for ultrasound when resources are limited, for weight grading.
map.识别巨大儿/低体重的粗略信号。: A rough signal for identifying macrosomia or low birth weight.
map.宫高腹围法: Fundal height and abdominal girth method
map.：宫高 32cm、腹围 95cm：EFW ≈ 32×95×0.3 = 912g（: : Fundal height 32 cm, abdominal girth 95 cm: EFW about 32 x 95 x 0.3 = 912 g (a rough estimate, strongly affected by abdominal wall fat, for reference only).
map.：头位宫高 32cm：EFW ≈ (32−12)×155 = 3100g，与超声: : With fundal height 32 cm for a cephalic presentation: EFW about (32 - 12) x 155 = 3100 g, close to the ultrasound figure of 3100 g, suggesting normal weight.
map.宫高腹围法准吗？: Is the fundal height and abdominal girth method accurate?
map.误差较大（±15–20%），受孕妇胖瘦、羊水、胎位影响；仅作筛查，确诊以超声 H: The error is large (+/-15-20%) and affected by maternal body fat, amniotic fluid and fetal position; it is screening only, and confirmation uses the ultrasound Hadlock formula.
map.腹围系数 0.3 怎么来的？: Where does the 0.3 abdominal girth coefficient come from?
map.是经验简化系数（宫高×腹围×0.3 对应以 cm 计的参数），不同人群略有差异，: It is an empirical simplified coefficient (fundal height x abdominal girth x 0.3 for parameters measured in cm); it varies somewhat between populations and cannot replace the standard formula.
